infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: WithUrooj uses the camera so cleaners can photograph the site before starting a job and the finished work before completing it. These photos are attached to the booking.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: WithUrooj needs access to your photos so you can attach a profile picture, identity documents for verification, or a photo of the job.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: WithUrooj uses your location to suggest your address and to show your cleaner on the map while a job is active.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: WithUrooj uses your location to detect your address and match you with nearby cleaners.

plugins.photosPermission: WithUrooj needs access to your photos so you can attach a profile picture, verification documents or job photos.
plugins.cameraPermission: WithUrooj uses the camera for before and after job photos and for identity verification.
